requested: Use Hugging Face for this (owner, 2026-10-25): make Senna's art with the Hugging Face image tools and replace the placeholders.
note: Raw outputs of the image tools, kept unchanged. scripts/art/senna.py turns them into the game images in art-src/routes/SEN/. The neutral portrait is generated from text; the other four expressions and the illustration are edits of it, so her face, hair and clothes stay the same.

neutral.prompt: Highly detailed anime fantasy light-novel character illustration, vibrant colors, soft painterly shading, glossy hair highlights, sparkling detailed eyes, delicate line art. Waist-up portrait, facing the viewer, plain pale cream background. An elegant young adult princess who works as an apothecary: narrow oval face, straight eyebrows, clear smooth skin, hazel-grey eyes, calm composed expression with a hint of dry amusement. Honey-blonde hair in a loose low bun with a wooden pencil and a sprig of rosemary pushed through it, a few loose strands framing her face; round gold wire spectacles resting on top of her head. High-collared long-sleeved plum velvet gown with small gold buttons and gold leaf embroidery, under a canvas apothecary apron with pockets holding small glass vials, a coil of twine and a leather notebook. Fully clothed, high neckline, long sleeves.
neutral.negative_prompt: freckles, mole, dot on forehead, bindi, flower, rose, text, letters, label text, watermark, signature, bare shoulders, cleavage, low neckline, exposed skin, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, low resolution, flat colors, chibi
neutral.review: Kept. The model added a small red rose to her hair despite the negative prompt; it reads as part of her look and is kept on every image.

lamplight.prompt: Show her seated at a wooden infirmary worktable in warm lamplight at night, sorting dried herbs into small glass jars, shelves of jars behind her, her spectacles on her nose, a small tired smile. Keep her face, hair, rose, pencil and clothes the same. Wide 4:3 scene, same painterly anime style, fully clothed.
lamplight.review: Kept on the first try. Seated on a chair at the worktable, packing dried herbs into jars, wall lamp and shelves of jars behind. Her face, hair, rose, rosemary, pencil and gold-embroidered plum gown match the portraits; her eyes read amber in the warm light. She kept her spectacles pushed up on her head, as in every portrait, rather than on her nose. Fully clothed; both hands drawn correctly. The notebook on the table has faint illegible scribbles, no readable text. Earlier attempts (2026-10-26/27) were refused by the free GPU allowance, and a FLUX.1 schnell text-only try was rejected for not matching her (see docs/art/SENNA_ART_PROMPTS.md).
